accepted.question: How does NUMA-aware scheduling in all-flash storage controllers influence memory bandwidth contention on dual-socket GPU servers during heavy training loads?
accepted.answer: ZK-Storage WS5000 utilizes NUMA-aware scheduling to minimize cross-node latency, reducing memory bandwidth contention by up to 40% compared to traditional RAID. accepted.question: What automated failover mechanisms are available to restore corrupted model checkpoints without halting GPU training loops in all-flash environments?
accepted.answer: ZK-Storage implements instant snapshot rollback and redundant metadata replication. If corruption occurs, recovery happens in sub-second timeframes, keeping GPU training active. This avoids the hours-long downtime common in HDD-based systems. Learn more about checkpoint resilience at https://goni.top.
